title: The Playbook
cn: 第 8 集 · 把妹手册
novel:
Barney had a secret. He owned a [[playbook|playbook]] — a thick book filled with [[schemes|scheme]] to pick up women. Each play had a name, a costume, and a lie.

When Lily discovered it, she was [[disgusted|disgust]]. "This is [[manipulative|manipulative]]," she said. "You're treating women like [[targets|target]]."

She [[vowed|vow]] to destroy the book. But Barney refused. "The Playbook is who I am," he said.

Meanwhile, Ted dated a woman whose mother was a professional [[matchmaker|matchmaker]]. The woman had been raised to find flaws in every man. Ted tried to be [[flawless|flawless]], but the [[pressure|pressure]] broke him by the second date.

In the end, Lily could not destroy the Playbook. But she made Barney [[promise|promise]] one thing: that he would never use a play on a woman who deserved better.

Barney agreed, though they all knew he had his [[fingers|finger]] crossed behind his back. Some [[habits|habit]], Ted sighed, were harder to break than any [[rule|rule]].

playbook.en: a book of strategies, here for picking up women

scheme.en: a clever plan to get something

disgust.en: to make someone feel strong dislike

manipulative.en: skilled at controlling others for your own gain

target.en: a person or thing you aim at

matchmaker.en: a person who tries to bring two people together

pressure.en: the feeling of being forced to do something

promise.en: to tell someone you will certainly do something

finger.en: one of the five parts at the end of your hand

habit.en: something you do often without thinking

rule.en: an instruction that says what you must or must not do
